limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: CLI streaming mode, MCP progress and the unfinished stream guarantees
limitations.impact: There is no CLI `--stream` option and no MCP progress reporting for recovery, and the live semantic-prefix equivalence and semantic-search revision guarantees of `ToolCallStream` remain unfinished.
